meta.title: HarnessAMS
meta.description: HarnessAMS top-level plugin: three-tier UI (global console page over /harnessams APIs, project = DSH workspace, per-session sidebar) plus remote machines over @linxin666/dsh-ssh, the project self-check, disk usage, digital assets, the managed scan channel (batch_submit with its local/direct/lsf schedulers, batch_poll monitoring with terminal auto-fetch) and the simulator-agnostic tools (gen_sweep_report/safe_trash)
